scripts.check: bun run check:schema && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check:schema: bun run schema && git diff --exit-code -- backend/clipsieve/models.py frontend/src/lib/types.ts
scripts.dev: bun run --filter frontend dev & (cd backend && uv run uvicorn clipsieve.app:app --reload --port 8000); wait
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn clipsieve.app:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.format: bunx ultracite fix && (cd backend && uv run ruff format .)
scripts.lint: bunx ultracite check && (cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .)
scripts.schema: cd backend && uv run python ../packages/schema/generate.py && bun run --filter @clipsieve/schema generate
scripts.test: (cd backend && uv run pytest -q) && bun run --filter frontend test
